In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ethnography is a complex and dynamic process in which consultants are active participants in constructing the ethnographic text.
the ethnographic encounter is a site of struggle over the production of meaning, in which the ethnographer's authority is constantly challenged.

the ethnographer is a textual being who is always already a part of the text, a text that he or she is attempting to understand, but which is always already in the process of understanding him or her.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ethnographic project is an intertextual dialectic between the textual authority of the fieldwork encounter and the textual authority of ethnographic discourse.
ethnography is a form of cultural practice, a social relation between consultants and fieldworkers, a textual practice, a form of knowledge and a form of understanding.
the text of a culture is not the same as the text of the culture.

the ethnographer is always a stranger.
